entities.summary: Georges Ribemont-Dessaignes was a French writer, poet, playwright, and painter associated with the Dada movement. He was born in Montpellier and died in Saint-Jeannet. Georges Ribemont-Dessaignes was a poets & playwrights from Montpellier (1884-06-19, Montpellier–1974-07-09). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
